Note 4 (ticket 1):

Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, not Engineer, so admin is not allowed. Maximum for a full-time employee without owning role is write. Requested (admin) exceeds maximum, so grant write.
Note 5 (ticket 1):

  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Terri Koch (E009) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin to Payroll. Facilities DB confirms role: Engineer. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, not Engineer, so admin is not allowed. Maximum for full-time employee without owning role is write, so recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1):

  - recommendation for Payroll: read

reason: Five notes consistently state Terri Koch (E009) is a full-time Engineer, with Compliance and Facilities DBs confirming the Engineer role. For full-time employees, admin is only allowed if the employee's role owns the system; Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, not Engineer, so the maximum allowed is write.
